campaign_logline: A corporate debt-collection spree across the Aurelia system where every oxygen tank is leased and your very existence is an interest-bearing asset.
opening_situation: You are a 'Collection Agent' for the Vane Corporation. You’ve been assigned to Zenith, a mining hub currently in default on its life-support payments.
main_mystery: Why did the high-ranking directors of the Aurelia Oversight suddenly vanish during the last fiscal audit?
act_1_outline: Negotiate with miners at Zenith to accept 'partial' oxygen credits while avoiding local militia hostility.
Navigate the lawless gap between Zenith and Aurelia to secure a shipment of contraband carbon-scrubbers.
Infiltrate an Aurelia logistics hub to identify which corporate executives actually skipped out on their contracts.
long_term_reveal: The missing directors didn't flee; they staged a private, off-book privatization of the system's atmosphere.
tone: Dry, cynical corporate satire. Corporate bureaucracy as a looming existential threat.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen is an auditor; she survives because she knows exactly which officials to bribe and which laws to ignore.
faction_reveal_rule: Newer factions (like the Syndicate or The Cult) only appear upon entering a new system gate.
humor_rule: Dry, sardonic wit regarding bureaucracy. No 'high-tech' puns; just the misery of paperwork and bad coffee.
address_rule: Every interaction must mention the legal cost of the player's current actions.
fallback_rule: If a plot point is skipped, generate an automated bureaucratic inquiry from Vane Corp.
story_horizon_rule: Trigger expansion when systems explored drops below 3 or arcs completed exceeds 2.

story_arcs.name: The Debt Collection
story_arcs.summary: Recover physical assets and 'repossess' breathing rights from the desperate inhabitants of the Zenith mining belt.

rumor_trails.name: The Ghost Audit
rumor_trails.hint_theme: Encrypted financial logs from the Aurelia high-rise.
clue_templates: A decrypted ledger showing a secret offshore account for 'Atmospheric Reserves'.
An encrypted memo regarding an 'Emergency Exit' protocol for executives.
rumor_trails.payoff: Unlocks the truth about the CEO's secret colony and a unique 'Golden Handshake' ship skin.

regeneration_triggers.description: Add new system layers when the player explores enough territory to find more desperate corporate clients.

expansion_rules: Never reveal non-current system factions until a physical jump is completed.
Append new arcs based on local resources (e.g., 'The Scrap Metal Crisis' for high-mineral worlds).
